# CHEZZIES

> CHEZZIES is an online chess adventure game for kids. Explore a fantasy world and practice chess through interactive challenges, free in your browser.

CHEZZIES (also written CHEZZIES Chess) is a chess adventure game for young beginners at https://chezzies.app/, available in English and Spanish (https://chezzies.app/es/). Children choose a hero (Laserhorse, Ladiator or Officer Cannon), travel a fantasy world map, solve chess challenges in themed fortresses and play full games against computer opponents in the Arena.

## Key facts

- Price: Free. No subscriptions, purchases or paid content limits.
- Ads: No ads.
- Download: None needed. CHEZZIES runs in a web browser.
- Devices: Phones, tablets and desktop computers.
- Opponents: Computer opponents in the Arena. No live multiplayer and no player chat.
- Account: Optional. Guest progress stays in the browser; a free account saves the adventure online across devices.
- Chess skills: Piece movement, checkmate, forks, pins, double attacks and defense.
- Language: English.

## Pages

- [Play CHEZZIES](https://chezzies.app/play/): the game itself
- [Chess Games for Kids](https://chezzies.app/chess-games-for-kids/): A good chess game for kids makes practice feel like play. CHEZZIES offers short chess challenges, computer opponents and a fantasy world to explore for free in your browser.
- [Online Chess for Kids](https://chezzies.app/online-chess-for-kids/): CHEZZIES is a free browser-based chess adventure for kids. Choose a hero, solve short challenges and face computer opponents in the Arena.
- [Learn Chess for Kids](https://chezzies.app/learn-chess-for-kids/): Kids can learn chess one idea at a time through short practice. CHEZZIES introduces piece movement, checkmate, forks, pins and defense in an interactive adventure.
- [How to Play Chess for Kids](https://chezzies.app/how-to-play-chess-for-kids/): Chess is a two-player game where each side moves one piece per turn. Learn the board, how pieces move and how to win by checkmate, then practise in CHEZZIES.
- [Chess Puzzles for Kids](https://chezzies.app/chess-puzzles-for-kids/): Solve 64 free chess puzzles for kids from the CHEZZIES game: checkmate in one, forks, pins, double attacks and defense. Each puzzle asks for one move and has a hint and the answer.
- [CHEZZIES for parents](https://chezzies.app/parents/): CHEZZIES is a free browser-based chess adventure for young beginners. Children choose a hero, solve chess challenges, explore a fantasy map and play against computer opponents.

## Español

- [CHEZZIES en español](https://chezzies.app/es/): CHEZZIES es un juego de aventuras de ajedrez para niños. Explora un mundo de fantasía y practica ajedrez con retos interactivos, gratis en tu navegador.
- [Jugar a CHEZZIES](https://chezzies.app/es/play/): el juego en español
- [Juegos de ajedrez para niños](https://chezzies.app/es/juegos-de-ajedrez-para-ninos/): Un buen juego de ajedrez para niños hace que practicar se sienta como jugar. CHEZZIES ofrece retos cortos de ajedrez, rivales de computadora y un mundo de fantasía para explorar gratis en tu navegador.
- [Ajedrez online para niños](https://chezzies.app/es/ajedrez-online-para-ninos/): CHEZZIES es una aventura de ajedrez gratis para niños que se juega en el navegador. Elige un héroe, resuelve retos cortos y enfrenta a rivales de computadora en la Arena.
- [Aprender ajedrez para niños](https://chezzies.app/es/aprender-ajedrez-para-ninos/): Los niños pueden aprender ajedrez una idea a la vez con práctica corta. CHEZZIES enseña cómo se mueven las piezas, el jaque mate, la horquilla, la clavada y la defensa en una aventura interactiva.
- [Cómo jugar ajedrez para niños](https://chezzies.app/es/como-jugar-ajedrez-para-ninos/): El ajedrez es un juego para dos personas en el que cada bando mueve una pieza por turno. Aprende el tablero, cómo se mueven las piezas y cómo se gana con jaque mate, y luego practica en CHEZZIES.
- [Problemas de ajedrez para niños](https://chezzies.app/es/problemas-de-ajedrez-para-ninos/): Resuelve 64 problemas de ajedrez gratis del juego CHEZZIES: jaque mate en una jugada, horquillas, clavadas, ataques dobles y defensa. Cada problema pide una jugada y tiene una pista y la solución.
- [CHEZZIES para madres y padres](https://chezzies.app/es/padres/): CHEZZIES es una aventura de ajedrez gratis en el navegador para principiantes. Los niños eligen un héroe, resuelven retos de ajedrez, exploran un mapa de fantasía y juegan contra rivales de computadora.
